verdict.rationale: Automation rules, such as auto-scanning or auto-forwarding mail when it arrives, are a fair axis for a virtual mailbox service, so the story applies. However, the evidence only shows manual, per-item requests ("with a few taps, you can request that the operator open and scan"). Scheduling a pickup is a one-off action, not an event-triggered rule. No rule engine, triggers or automation features are documented, and the API and llms.txt probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
